description: order_summary(item_name, price_cents) in orders.py should return a formatted price string using format_price(cents) from formatting.py. format_price already expects an amount in cents. orders.py currently multiplies price_cents by 100 again before calling format_price, double-scaling the value. Fix the bug in orders.py's call to format_price -- do not change format_price's contract in formatting.py, since other callers depend on it.
constraints: do not change formatting.py's format_price signature or contract
